subject.title: feat(browser): add GPT-5.6 Sol model aliases

question: Should Oracle permanently expose both a moving `gpt-5.6` alias and a pinned `gpt-5.6-sol` alias?
rationale: The aliases intentionally establish different future compatibility semantics, which tests and current ChatGPT behavior cannot decide.

options.title: Keep both aliases
options.body: Retain the moving family alias and pinned Sol alias after repairing custom-model passthrough.

options.title: Keep pinned Sol only
options.body: Expose only the stable picker-specific alias until Oracle has a documented family-alias policy.

recommendation.title: Keep both aliases
